stages.effectText: ASPD +30 when there are stored attacks

Enemies hit by attacks or stored energy will receive 100 Arts damage every second for 5 seconds (stacking up to 4 times, enemies hit by [Transposing Energy] will immediately take 3 stacks). Will not target enemies inflicted with this status.
